comment: UK -> Viet Nam localisation. Service numbers (999, 111) match only as whole numbers, never inside 1,999 or 9.99; GPs is case-sensitive (GPS is a device). source_rewrites turn UK-only services into neutral English BEFORE machine translation (first match wins per position, rules run in order). forbidden_in_target must never appear in the Vietnamese text; discouraged_in_target only flags the chunk for a human reviewer. The tables are also shown to the LLM post-editor.

source_rewrites.pattern: \bask for an urgent GP appointment or (?:get help from|get advice from|call) (?:NHS )?111(?: online\b)?(?![.,]?\d)

number_format.comment: how the Vietnamese text writes numbers; a copied English 1,500 or 1.5 is rewritten from its source value

tolerated_by_source_comment: numbers the Vietnamese line may add when the source matches: month names (case-sensitive), ages of age_table, fractions, "a month" -> 1 tháng; only silences the soft numbers_added warning
target_replacements_comment: fixed wording applied to the final Vietnamese line; a rule with source applies only when the English line matches it

units_comment: a unit of the source line must stay in the Vietnamese line (5 mg -> 5 g changes a dose); hard check; (?<![^\W\d_]) = not after a letter, so '2mg' counts
direction_checks_comment: an age, dose or limit must keep its direction: 'under 5' never becomes 'trên 5'; {n} is the number of the source; flagged for review
negation_comment: a source line with a negation needs one in the Vietnamese line; flagged for review; source_exempt: phrases a correct translation says without a negation ('do not eat as much' -> 'ăn ít hơn')
meaning_checks_comment: wording a reviewer returned in SCRUM-148; a rule applies when the source line matches 'source' and not 'unless_source'; 'forbid' must not be in the Vietnamese line, 'require' must be; 'on': 'rewritten' tests the source after source_rewrites; the hint is sent to the LLM repair round; flagged for review
